# Vectant

> Vectant issues wrapped assets on the Canton Network. The product is on testnet and is not on mainnet. A public certificate of reserves and an independent audit are not published yet.

Preferred host: https://www.vectant.xyz/

## Instruments

- cWETH: wrapped Ether, Safe on EVM, testnet
- cSOL: wrapped SOL, Squads on Solana, in build
- Tokenized gold: roadmap
- Tokenized securities: roadmap
- Partner assets: onboarding, not live

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vectant.xyz/): product summary
- [How it works](https://www.vectant.xyz/how-it-works): lock, mint, redeem
- [Assets](https://www.vectant.xyz/assets): instrument register
- [Security](https://www.vectant.xyz/security): custody design
- [Proof of reserves](https://www.vectant.xyz/proof-of-reserves): not published yet
- [FAQ](https://www.vectant.xyz/faq): short answers
- [Blog](https://www.vectant.xyz/blog): the same topics in longer notes

## Partners

Vectant is partnering with these venues. Vectant assets are not integrated on them yet.

- [Helvex](https://www.helvex.cc/): permissioned RFQ desk on Canton
- [Meridiant](https://meridiant.xyz/): isolated-market lending on Canton
